An '''ascension gun''' was any weapon that carried a grappling hook launcher, commonly in conjunction with a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|liquid-cable launcher]] or a [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] tether.

==Description==
[[File:AscentionGun-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|250px|An ascension gun attachment on an S-5 heavy blaster pistol]]
The ascension gun was generally a grappling-dart launcher which launched a tether made of syntherope attached to a weapon, such as a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]]. The user could switch the weapon from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] mode to ascension mode. When fired in ascension mode, the weapon shot a grappling dart attached to the syntherope, tethering the weapon to the target. If the tether was launched vertically, the ascension gun could quickly pull the wielder upward, with a maximum vertical lift capacity of roughly 720 kg. The ascension gun could also be used to create a horizontal zipline to a target surface. The zipline allowed the wielder to quickly slide along the line if the destination had a lower elevation. In ascension mode, the tether had a maximum range of 45 meters.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

The ascension gun had a capacity of 50 shots, after which the [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] would need replacing. Additionally, the ascension gun carried only two lengths of syntherope; after 2 uses, the syntherope had to be replaced. The ascension gun was restricted to military use.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

The [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistol]] used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] had a ascension gun attachment. 

==History==
[[File:Ascension_gun_TPM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Queen Amidala and her team use ascension guns to scale the walls of Theed Palace.]]
The [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistol]] used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]] could be easily configured to operate as an ascension gun. [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] and [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Captain Panaka]] used the S-5's grappling hook launcher to scale the walls of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], during their ultimately successful attempt to capture [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] used ascension guns like [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], and [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]].
[[File:LukeHarpoon.png|thumb|Luke using a harpoon gun to destroy an AT-At.]]
At the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a magnetic harpoon gun from his damaged [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] to lift himself underneath an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]], where he used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slice open a section of the assault vehicle's belly. Skywalker threw a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] into the breach, and released the harpoon, falling to the snowy ground moments before the walker exploded.
